featured_machines.title: Godzilla Pro
featured_machines.tagline: The king of the monsters rules the playfield with multi-level ramps and a jaw-dropping motorized Mechagodzilla upper playfield.

featured_machines.title: Wonka
featured_machines.tagline: Jersey Jack's whimsical masterpiece channels pure imagination across a hand-painted playfield bursting with Oompa-Loompa surprises.

featured_machines.title: Halloween
featured_machines.tagline: Spooky Pinball's licensed tribute to the classic slasher franchise features Michael Myers lurking through shadowy original artwork.

featured_machines.title: Houdini: Master of Mystery
featured_machines.tagline: American Pinball's debut machine evokes the showmanship of the legendary illusionist through illusion-themed modes and a striking art package.

featured_machines.title: Medieval Madness (Remake)
featured_machines.tagline: Chicago Gaming Company's faithful recreation of the beloved Williams classic lets a new generation storm castles and slay trolls.

featured_machines.title: P3 Pinball Platform
featured_machines.tagline: Multimorphic's modular P3 platform redefines what a pinball machine can be: swap game kits and transform the experience without changing the cabinet.
